## Public Claims Release Gate

Complete this section before merging any change that can affect public copy,
product framing, demos, metrics, named organisations, outcomes, or
clinical-adjacent language.

- [ ] I reviewed [`docs/public-claims-policy.md`](../docs/public-claims-policy.md).
- [ ] I updated [`docs/public-claims-evidence-register.md`](../docs/public-claims-evidence-register.md), or this change makes no public claim.
- [ ] Every metric, partner, capability, and outcome statement is verified, explicitly illustrative, or removed.
- [ ] Any demo or scenario is labelled where a reader encounters it.
- [ ] The release has a named owner and a review date for any new public claim.

> Do not merge a public-surface change with an unchecked item above. The release
> owner resolves the claim or removes it before publication.
